{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of missing age entries (customer_age = -1): {len(missing_age)}')

# Check revenue format
print(f'Unique revenue values (first 10): {df["revenue"].unique()[:10]}')

# Confirm the presence of QA and refunded orders
print(f'QA order rows:
{qa_orders.head()}')
print(f'Refunded order rows:
{refunded_orders.head()}')"}
